While denser than typical, reference 3 shows double-spike cycles and high micro-oscillation density; the spike widths (~3 pts) are only slightly narrower than normal (4–6 pts), and amplitude (≤−1.0) falls within normal trough range (−0.7 to −1.0). No evidence of disrupted stepwise baseline—recovery slopes are consistent with reference 2’s asymmetric recovery. Hence, this is normal morphological variation, not a shapelet anomaly; candidate 2 is removed.
